issues.description: The template's StockIngredient class provides a quantity getter named retrieveQuantity(), while other code (Stock.java in the template and the problem statement expectation of standard getters) calls getQuantity(). This naming mismatch will cause compilation errors and prevents students from running or testing their code. The solution repository uses getQuantity(), indicating retrieveQuantity() in the template is unintended.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the quantity getter in the template StockIngredient from retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity() so it matches Stock.java usage and the common getter naming convention. Alternatively, update Stock.java (and any other callers) to use retrieveQuantity(), but renaming to getQuantity() is preferred to align with the problem statement and the solution implementation.
